viz_reviews.summary: The page is unmistakably Cynefin: four quadrants in the canonical arrangement, Disorder centred, the cliff between Chaotic and Clear, each domain box carrying its protocol. Facts-only leaves a coherent skeleton of situations and quoted signals; derived adds the indicates/classified_as/calls_for edges, the responses and the cross-quadrant 'treated as' edges that carry the example's point. Gold rings make the idea-bearing response slot easy to find. Stats match graph.json (classic 11/5/5 nodes, 5/19/6 edges; tbpn 14/5/5, 4/26/7), console clean, zero overlaps / off-screen / under cards. Remaining flaws are node meshes over region captions and a few labels, all still readable.

notes: Research: Cynefin (Dave Snowden, IBM Institute of Knowledge Management, 1999; popularised in Snowden & Boone, 'A Leader's Framework for Decision Making', HBR Nov 2007). Five domains, each with its own causality and its own decision protocol: Clear/Obvious (cause-effect self-evident, best practice, Sense-Categorise-Respond), Complicated (cause-effect knowable with analysis or expertise, good practice, Sense-Analyse-Respond), Complex (cause-effect only coherent in retrospect, emergent practice, Probe-Sense-Respond), Chaotic (no usable cause-effect, novel practice, Act-Sense-Respond), Disorder (you do not know which domain you are in, so everyone argues from their preferred domain). Design decisions: the five domains are structural scaffolding (provenance schema, reserved grey); situations and signals are facts from the source; the classification is a derived edge carrying confidence; the prescribed response is a derived node and is the idea-bearing slot; the page's point is a situation handled with the wrong domain's protocol (a blueprint over an emergent space). Layout: plane, four quadrant regions with Disorder in the centre. Scout returned three candidates (2025-08-27 SpaceX/Starship; 2025-04-04 AI 2027 forecast; 2025-12-04 brand crisis with Katie Deighton). Chose candidate 1 but narrowed it to one continuous stretch (L60-L560) about SpaceX cost decisions, so the example is one coherent moment rather than a tour of the episode; the Cracker Barrel and Lindy material from the same episode was dropped for that reason. Validate: 0 errors, 0 warnings. Added one relation beyond the registry, observed_in (signal belongs to a situation), because the registry relation indicates carries the domain judgment and is therefore always derived; observed_in is what can be a fact edge when one span of the source states an observation as part of a situation, and it is what keeps the facts-only view connected. Known honest limit: in plane mode a situation's quadrant position encodes its classification, which is itself derived, so the facts-only view still shows situations sitting in domains; the classification edges disappear but the placement does not. Noted rather than fixed, because the brief requires the page to read as the Cynefin diagram at a glance.
